items.headline: $JUP Launches Wild 1,000x Leverage YOLO Beta
items.summary: Jupiter rolled out an unaudited YOLO beta with up to 1,000x leverage, where users trade against a house pool. Payouts can be queued if house funds run low — degen season is on.

items.headline: $STRK Vote: Starknet Eyes Its Own Quantum-Safe L1
items.summary: Starknet opened a seven-day vote asking $STRK holders whether to research an independent post-quantum Layer 1, potentially moving away from Ethereum settlement.

items.headline: $HEX Craters 31% After Richard Heart Detention
items.summary: $HEX sank 31% on reports of founder Richard Heart's detention in Istanbul. Thin liquidity — just $354K in the main Uniswap pool — is adding execution risk for sellers.

items.headline: $SAFE Launches Safenet Aegis Security Network
items.summary: Safe launched Safenet Aegis, a security network live on three chains. Checks cost 0.40 USDC paid to security providers, with onchain enforcement via a Guard on the account.

items.headline: $AZTEC Targets Full Post-Quantum Migration by 2030
items.summary: Privacy L2 Aztec plans a full post-quantum migration by end of 2030, with hardened developer libraries coming in early 2027. The move also depends on Ethereum upgrades.
